archetypes.name: Takomo — Product Hero Studio Shot
archetypes.description: Single-subject product hero. Forge black backdrop, centered iron / head, single overhead light, brass accent rule under headline. The archetype the takomo-101t visual-dna was extracted from.

layers.treatment: single subject, sharp focus, soft top + bottom fade to background

archetypes.example_prompt_seed: Takomo 101T iron hero: forge black backdrop, single overhead light, brass rule, 'Forged for the strike'.

archetypes.name: Takomo — Spec Card
archetypes.description: Forge black backdrop, single-column spec list (loft / lie / length / shaft / grip) in brass + alloy white, with the iron head as a small bottom-right hero. Built for 'what makes this iron different' education posts.
archetypes.example_prompt_seed: Takomo 101T spec card: loft 28° | lie 59° | length 39" | shaft DG S300 | grip Tour Velvet. Black backdrop, brass label rail.

fallback_when_no_image_gen: produce copy-only deliverables (headline + caption + CTA + archetype spec). The product hero archetype is the priority for any post that pairs copy with an existing club photo (the takomo-101t campaign has 1 brand image already).
source: best-guess from takomo-101t visual-dna (single dark studio product shot, centered subject, brass accent) and common premium club-maker social patterns (Sub 70, PXG, Takomo). Needs Drive validation once folders are wired in.
